subtitle: Spec Kit [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] example
title: Enterprise SSO Login
lead: Clarification page extracted from a GitHub Spec Kit spec.md. Reuses the shared team context from examples/generic-plan/context.json and demonstrates multi-rule mootWhen branching.

keystone.openBanner: Decide protocol scope first (OIDC vs. SAML 2.0): choosing OIDC-only removes SAML metadata and certificate rotation questions.
keystone.mootBanner: OIDC-only selected: SAML-specific metadata/certificate questions are greyed out.

questions.title: SSO protocol scope for v1
questions.question: Which SSO protocol(s) must v1 support?
questions.context: spec.md [NEEDS CLARIFICATION #1]. No protocol is committed yet.
options: OIDC only (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace)
questions.reason: OIDC covers major enterprise IdPs with far simpler token validation and zero XML signature complexity for v1.

questions.title: SAML metadata & certificate rotation
questions.question: How do target enterprise tenants distribute SAML IdP metadata and rotate signing certificates?
questions.context: spec.md [NEEDS CLARIFICATION #2]. Fact question: depends on enterprise customer IdP operations.
options: Dynamic IdP metadata URL polled automatically
Static XML upload + manual certificate rollover window
questions.reason: No proposal: fact question — Business/Customer Success knows what target enterprise IT departments actually provide.

questions.title: Just-in-Time (JIT) account provisioning
questions.question: Should first-time SSO logins create user accounts automatically or require pre-invited accounts?
questions.context: spec.md [NEEDS CLARIFICATION #3]. Affects license billing and security approval.
options: Enable JIT provisioning on valid IdP login
questions.reason: Pre-invited accounts avoid surprise seat billing and match conservative enterprise access policies; JIT can follow in v2.

questions.title: Default role for JIT-provisioned users
questions.question: If JIT provisioning is enabled, which role should newly created users receive by default?
questions.context: spec.md [NEEDS CLARIFICATION #4]. Only applies if JIT provisioning (SC-3) is enabled.
options: Configurable per tenant IdP group claim
questions.reason: Least privilege prevents accidental write/admin access on first login.

questions.title: Session lifetime & IdP revocation
questions.question: How long should local app sessions remain valid relative to IdP session expiry?
questions.context: spec.md [NEEDS CLARIFICATION #5]. Trade-off between security compliance and re-login friction.
options: Fixed 8-hour local session (re-authenticate via IdP afterward)
Match IdP token expiry + OIDC back-channel logout
questions.reason: 8-hour fixed session is simple, predictable, and avoids back-channel logout complexity in v1.
